from typing import List
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def solveQueries(self, nums: List[int], queries: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for i, v in enumerate(nums):
            groups[v].append(i)
        
        ans_map = {}
        for v, idxs in groups.items():
            k = len(idxs)
            if k == 1:
                ans_map[idxs[0]] = -1
                continue
            for j in range(k):
                i = idxs[j]
                prev_i = idxs[j - 1] if j > 0 else idxs[k - 1]
                next_i = idxs[j + 1] if j < k - 1 else idxs[0]
                d1 = abs(i - prev_i)
                d1 = min(d1, n - d1)
                d2 = abs(i - next_i)
                d2 = min(d2, n - d2)
                ans_map[i] = min(d1, d2)
        
        return [ans_map[q] for q in queries]
